text:
Laura: Alert flagged a misconfigured jump-proxy in staging that allowed outbound to telemetry S3 and invoked a CMK at 2026-03-15T22:10Z
Anil: Paste the alert and any CloudTrail entries please; need the principal that used kms:Decrypt
Laura: sec-alert EVT-5041: s3 PUT from ns=jump-proxy-staging -> s3://rdw-staging-telemetry @2026-03-15T22:11Z. CloudTrail shows svcacct:jump-proxy-sa called GenerateDataKey/Decrypt
Dave: quick kube check — found a permissive netpol left for debugging (egress: [{}]) in that ns
Mateo: that was my testing change, I forgot to revert — will remediate now
Sec-Bot: automated-audit: wildcard egress detected in namespace=jump-proxy-staging at 2026-03-15T22:07Z severity=high
Ruth (oncall): Contain + triage plan: 1) replace permissive netpol with least-priv egress to allowed telemetry endpoints; 2) rotate/refresh any tokens and switch SA to IRSA bound role; 3) snapshot KMS grants and export CloudTrail for 4h window; 4) run vuln triage on any unexpected decrypt activity
Mateo: applying lockdown netpol and preparing IRSA role with conditions (restrict sub to pod name + aud)
Dave: proposed lockdown netpol snippet ready for PR (restrict to collector hostnames / 443)
Anil: add a cluster default-deny egress policy to enforce deny-by-default so slips are visible
Laura: audit gap: k8s audit policy wasn't recording requestBody for token-exchange flows. Need to enable requestBody:true for write ops in jump namespaces and increase retention for private installs
Ruth (oncall): Runbook owners/timeboxes: (A) netpol+deny - @Mateo - within 30m; (B) export CloudTrail+KMS logs - @Anil - 1h; (C) revoke SA tokens/IRSA refresh - @Mateo; (D) snapshot key grants + rotation plan - @Laura; (E) post-incident RCA + compliance pack - @Ruth
Anil: pulling logs now; I see a flurry of GenerateDataKey/Decrypt correlated to the SA around 22:10, exporting CSV to incident artifacts
Laura: question for key rotation: telemetry uses envelope encryption; rewrapping blobs at once is expensive — prefer alias swap + lazy rewrap or background re-encrypt job
Dave: agree — create new CMK, update alias, and have consumers rewrap on write or via scheduled rewrap workers; document cost vs risk
Sec-Bot: iam-scan: role bound to the service account has kms:Decrypt broadly and lacks kms:ViaService / aws:SourceAccount constraints. Recommend tightening principals + conditions
Ruth (oncall): For private/on-prem deployments: avoid rotating root CMKs during production hours; ensure any KMS proxy enforces tenant principal checks and logs attempted cross-tenant decrypts for attestation
Mateo: opened PR with netpol + IRSA role + docs, tagging reviewers (link internal)
Laura: left review notes to prefer hostname L7 egress (SNI/Host) instead of broad CIDR to better prove egress constraints in customer reports
Anil: attached logs to INC-2026-0041 artifacts/kms-calls.csv and added a forensic CSV with principals and request IDs
Ruth (oncall): Evidence pack for customer isolation claim should include: 1) applied network manifests and deny-by-default proof; 2) KMS key policy snapshot + principal bindings; 3) audit log extracts (k8s + KMS) for chosen window; 4) replayed attestation test where cross-tenant decrypt is attempted and fails
Dave: operational mitigation: pipeline fallback on decrypt failure -> switch to ephemeral local key + mark items as rewrap-needed; add reconciliation job to re-encrypt when new key is available
Laura: Also add automated weekly attestation test that forges a token from a different namespace and asserts KMS denies it — archive results in compliance bundle
Ruth (oncall): Postmortem steps: verify audit policy updates, ensure Jira sec-audit ticket created for the IAM & audit changes, and prepare customer-facing isolation statement within 3h
Sec-Bot: reminder: escalate to sec-leads if any blocker on netpol or key operations
Mateo: lockdown and token refresh done; please validate in next 10m and confirm collected artifacts
Anil: logs exported and uploaded, starting correlation analysis for unusual decrypt patterns
Laura: drafting isolation proof doc and will include manifest diffs, KMS policy snapshot, and recorded attestation run
Ruth (oncall): Good work. Close after validation run and publish RCA in #postmortems. :thumbsup:
